questions.question: Who built the great ark to save his family from the flood?
questions.fact: Noah built the ark exactly as God commanded, even though it had never rained before.

questions.question: What did God create on the very first day?
questions.fact: God said, Let there be light, and there was light.

questions.question: How many days and nights did it rain during the great flood?
questions.fact: It rained for forty days and forty nights, and the waters lifted the ark.

questions.question: Who was the strongest man in the Bible, whose power was in his hair?
questions.fact: God gave Samson great strength, but his real weakness was telling Delilah his secret.

questions.question: What did David use to defeat the giant Goliath?
questions.fact: David chose five smooth stones from a stream and trusted God to give him the victory.

questions.question: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish after running away from God?
questions.fact: Jonah prayed from inside the fish, and God gave him a second chance to obey.

questions.question: How many commandments did God give to Moses on Mount Sinai?
questions.fact: The Ten Commandments teach us how to love God and love other people.

questions.question: What is the very first book of the Bible?
questions.fact: Genesis means beginning — it tells us how God created the world.

questions.question: Who betrayed Jesus with a kiss?
questions.fact: Even though Judas betrayed Him, Jesus still loved him — and He loves us too.

questions.question: What did Jesus use to feed more than five thousand people?
questions.fact: A boy shared his small lunch, and Jesus multiplied it into more than enough for everyone.
